scope: local PNG/APNG review only; raw CAM/XML reads; no CAM/TILE/package/game writes

stock_action_xml.timing_scope: Rate windows are stock XML facts; per-frame scheduler distribution is not proven. Review APNGs distribute each window uniformly in integer milliseconds.

stock_context_disclosure.text: Special64 also serves Basic_idle/item contexts.  These files approve art only and do not make potion-item use dispatch the drink animation.

topology_reconciliation.raw_stock_source: each direction's seven descriptor occurrences, metadata words, flags, attachments, exact low16 sequence, and derived symbolic_frame_pattern are preserved from the action authority plus direct raw-CAM reparse
topology_reconciliation.reason_for_both: private Cast TILE occurrences may differ even where stock reused one low16 reference; this removes the post-release bottle pop without changing the literal seven-slot descriptor lifecycle, order, flags, or runtime timing

registration.method: one centered action-wide overscan plus one fixed accepted V11 affine around the projected world root

runtime_self_check.implementation: install-free Pillow plus standard-library float arrays
runtime_self_check.accepted_algorithm: linear-light premultiplied reflect Gaussian then float-plane bicubic affine
